# Logger tests

Tests for the `@datainkio/lumberjack` logger.

## What's here

- `index.js`: runs the suite
- `*.test.js`: one file per area (styles, errors, optional parameters, real-world use)

## Run them

```bash
npm run test:logger
```

Some single files need `DEBUG=true`; see the `test:logger:*` scripts in `package.json`.
